<infobox theme="Star">
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="name"></title>
	<navigation name="mobile-eras"><center>{{Top-mobile}}</center></navigation>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Astrographical information</header>
        <data source="region"><label>Region(s)</label></data>	
        <data source="sector"><label>Sector</label><format>{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{sector|}}}}}|none||{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{sector|}}}}}|n/a||{{{sector|}}}}}}}</format></data>
        <data source="system"><label>System</label><format>{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{system|}}}}}|none||{{{system|}}}}}</format></data>
        <data source="coordinates"><label>Grid square</label><format>{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{coordinates|}}}}}|canon-only||{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{coordinates}}}}}|n/a||{{{coordinates|}}}}}}}</format></data>
        <data source="xyz"><label>XYZ coordinates</label></data>	
        <data source="distance"><label>Distance from Core</label></data>
        <data source="orbits"><label>Orbiting bodies</label></data>
        <data source="stations"><label>Space stations</label></data>
        <data source="asteroids"><label>Asteroids</label></data>
        <data source="routes"><label>Trade routes</label></data>		
        <data source="other"><label>Other objects</label></data>
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Physical information</header>
        <data source="class"><label>Class</label></data>	
        <data source="diameter"><label>Diameter</label></data>	
    </group>
    <navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:Star|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.

The following code flags infoboxes that do not have parameters defined.
-->{{#invoke:InfoboxParamCheck|main|image|name|region|sector|system|coordinates|xyz|routes|distance|orbits|stations|asteroids|other|class|diameter|optional=unlisted,no_grid_check|ignore=name}}<!--
-->{{#if:{{{no_grid_check|}}}||{{#if:{{NAMESPACE}}||{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{coordinates|}}}}}|canon-only|[[Category:Legends locations with canon-only grid coordinates]]|{{#invoke:PlanetGridCheck|main|outside=1|region={{{region|}}}|sector={{{sector|}}}|system={{{system|}}}|unlisted={{{unlisted|}}}}}}}}}}}<noinclude>[[category:Astrographical infobox templates]]{{clear}}

==Usage instructions==
{{AstroCategoryDoc}}

Copy and paste the following code into the top of the article, filling the appropriate fields. Omitted or blank fields will not be shown on the article page.
<pre><nowiki>{{Star
|image=
|name=
|region=
|sector=
|system=
|coordinates=
|xyz=
|distance=
|orbits=
|stations=
|asteroids=
|routes=
|other=
|class=
|diameter=
}}</nowiki></pre></noinclude>
